Exploring the Horizons of Education through Artificial Intelligence – eSchool Conference, Chtaura on 15-05-2025: About the Conference: eSchool organized its second conference titled 'Exploring Education Horizons Through Artificial Intelligence' at Park Hotel in Chtaura, Lebanon. The event gathered numerous school principals, curriculum supervisors, and educational coordinators. Learn more: https://web.myeschoolhome.com/news-events/P05ZajJaW8E CEO's Vision: Mr. Osama Ezzeddine, CEO of eSchool, welcomed attendees with a keynote speech, emphasizing the school's role in community development. He highlighted the significance of digital transformation in improving education and outlined eSchool's vision for integrating artificial intelligence into its platform. Learn more: https://web.myeschoolhome.com/news-events/P05ZajJaW8E Global Collaborations: Mr. Ezzeddine also shed light on the company's collaborations with global leaders in digital educational content, aimed at enriching the student learning experience with engaging and accessible resources. He concluded with a call to redefine education through modern, human-centered approaches that build knowledgeable and capable generations. Learn more: https://web.myeschoolhome.com/news-events/P05ZajJaW8E Platform Innovations: Ms. Rana Hamadeh, Head of the Training Department, followed with a comprehensive presentation on eSchool's applications, showcasing key services and upcoming AI-powered tools set to launch in the next academic year. She also presented the platform's interactive digital educational content in detail. Learn more: https://web.myeschoolhome.com/news-events/P05ZajJaW8E Networking & Collaboration: The conference concluded with lively networking sessions and productive discussions among participants and eSchool supporters, fostering new partnerships and innovative ideas for the future of education. Learn more: https://web.myeschoolhome.com/news-events/P05ZajJaW8E
